2010.title: Part B 图表作文：手机用户量增长情况对比
2010.apply_en:
The bar chart shows that the items associated with mobile-phone subscriptions in developing and developed countries rose steadily during the periods presented. Subscriptions in developing countries climbed from 0.5 billion in 2000 to 4 billion in 2008, while those in developed countries rose from 0.7 billion in 2000 to 1 billion in 2008.

Undoubtedly, the country's rapid economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for the emergence of mobile services. As the pace of life accelerates, individuals attach greater importance to convenience and efficiency and become increasingly willing to embrace new ways of living. Seen in this light, the development of mobile services is no coincidence but a natural consequence of broader changes in social life.

For mobile services to continue exerting a positive influence on personal growth, concerted efforts from all sectors of society are essential. Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which mobile services can play a constructive role. Individuals should also make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that mobile services genuinely contributes to their long-term development.
2010.apply_cn:
该柱状图表明，与发展中国家与发达国家的手机订阅量有关的不同项目在相应时期内均持续上升。发展中国家的订阅量由2000年的5亿上升至2008年的40亿，发达国家同期的订阅量则从2000年的7亿增至2008年的10亿。

毫无疑问，国家经济的飞速发展，为手机服务的出现奠定了坚实的物质基础。随着生活节奏加快，个人开始更加重视便利和效率，也更愿意接受新的生活方式。由此可见，手机服务的发展并非偶然，而是社会生活发生变化后的自然结果。

要使手机服务持续为个人成长带来积极影响，需要社会各方共同努力。有关部门应提供必要支持，为手机服务发挥作用创造良好条件。个人也应结合自身情况作出合理选择，使手机服务真正服务于自身的长期发展。

两个上升各用 climbed / rose 换词，末句用 the pace of growth differed sharply 点出"速度不同"，这是本题的题眼。
第二段用经济类模板，把 生活便利 换成 手机普及 语境（spread of mobile phones）。
数据只需首末两年，不必逐年罗列，控制字数在 150 词左右。

Growing public attention to domestic auto brands stems from its ability to meet practical needs in everyday life. Undoubtedly, the country's rapid economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for the emergence of domestic auto brands. As the pace of life accelerates, individuals attach greater importance to convenience and efficiency and become increasingly willing to embrace new ways of living.

For domestic auto brands to continue exerting a positive influence on personal growth, concerted efforts from all sectors of society are essential. Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which domestic auto brands can play a constructive role.

2012.title: Part B 图表作文：某公司员工工作满意度调查
2012.apply_en:
The table chart presents an uneven distribution among the categories associated with job satisfaction across the age groups. The group over 50 accounts for the largest share, at 40%. In contrast, employees aged 40 or younger and the remaining respondents make up relatively small proportions of 16.7% and a still smaller share. As for The group over 50 and those aged 41 to 50, they register 40% and the lowest level respectively.

The influence of job satisfaction is not confined to a single action; rather, it continues to shape the way individuals handle everyday responsibilities. Job satisfaction can enable individuals to approach routine tasks with greater maturity, preventing them from giving up too readily in the face of temporary difficulties. Ultimately, job satisfaction can not only improve individuals' present conduct but also strengthen their capacity for self-management, thereby laying a solid foundation for their future growth.

For job satisfaction to continue exerting a positive influence on personal growth, concerted efforts from all sectors of society are essential. Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which job satisfaction can play a constructive role.
2012.apply_cn:
该图表呈现了与各年龄段的工作满意度有关的不同类别之间不均衡的分布情况。50岁以上群体所占比例最大，达到40%。相比之下，40岁及以下员工和其余受访者所占比例较小，分别为16.7%和更小的比例。就50岁以上群体与41至50岁的员工而言，它们分别为40%和最低水平。

工作满意度的作用，并不会局限于某一次行为，而会持续影响个人处理日常事务的方式。工作满意度能够使个人以更加成熟的态度处理日常任务，不因暂时困难就轻易放弃。最终，工作满意度不仅能够改善个人当下的行为表现，也会增强其自我管理能力，为今后的成长提供稳定支持。

要使工作满意度持续为个人成长带来积极影响，需要社会各方共同努力。有关部门应提供必要支持，为工作满意度发挥作用创造良好条件。
tips: 本题图表是**表格（table）**：首句把 chart 换成 This table，这是最容易失分的地方。
数据是"分组比高低"而非时间变化 → 用**静态**第一段模板（largest share / middle group / relatively small）。
41-50 岁组"无人满意 + 64% 不满"是本题最关键的对比，务必写出。
第二段可套校园类/经济类模板，落点写"职业平台期（career plateau）"。

Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which part-time jobs can play a constructive role. 2014.title: Part B 大作文：城市与乡村人口的变化
2014.apply_en:
The bar chart shows that the items associated with the urban and rural population did not move in a uniform direction during the periods presented. The urban population climbed from 300 million in 1990 to 670 million in 2010, while the rural population rose from 820 million in 1990 to 680 million in 2010.

Undoubtedly, the country's rapid economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for the emergence of urbanization. As the pace of life accelerates, individuals attach greater importance to convenience and efficiency and become increasingly willing to embrace new ways of living. Seen in this light, the development of urbanization is no coincidence but a natural consequence of broader changes in social life.

For urbanization to continue exerting a positive influence on personal growth, concerted efforts from all sectors of society are essential. Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which urbanization can play a constructive role. Individuals should also make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that urbanization genuinely contributes to their long-term development.
2014.apply_cn:

The influence of travel is not confined to a single action; rather, it continues to shape the way individuals handle everyday responsibilities. Travel can enable individuals to approach routine tasks with greater maturity, preventing them from giving up too readily in the face of temporary difficulties. Ultimately, travel can not only improve individuals' present conduct but also strengthen their capacity for self-management, thereby laying a solid foundation for their future growth.

Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which travel can play a constructive role. Individuals should also make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that travel genuinely contributes to their long-term development.

2017.apply_en:
The line chart shows that the items associated with the number of museums and museum visitors rose steadily during the periods presented. The number of museums climbed from 4,169 in 2013 to 4,692 in 2015, while the number of visitors rose from 637 million in 2013 to 954 million in 2015. From 2013 to 2015, The number of museums rose from 4,169 to 4,692, showing a steady upward trend.

Traditional culture cannot be effectively conveyed through the one-way delivery of content alone; its modes of expression must also be adjusted in response to real-world feedback. Museums can establish a channel of communication between traditional culture and the public, allowing cultural content to be explained with greater clarity. Public participation can also give rise to new forms of cultural expression, enabling traditional culture to adapt to social change while preserving its core values.

Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which museums can play a constructive role. Individuals should also make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that museums genuinely contributes to their long-term development.

有关部门应提供必要支持，为博物馆发挥作用创造良好条件。个人也应结合自身情况作出合理选择，使博物馆真正服务于自身的长期发展。

第二段是文化类话题，用文化自信类模板的经济/文化双因（国家投入 + 生活水平）。

By contrast, the proportion starting a business fell from 1.3% in 2013 to 2.6% in 2018.

The influence of further education is not confined to a single action; rather, it continues to shape the way individuals handle everyday responsibilities. Further education can enable individuals to approach routine tasks with greater maturity, preventing them from giving up too readily in the face of temporary difficulties. Ultimately, further education can not only improve individuals' present conduct but also strengthen their capacity for self-management, thereby laying a solid foundation for their future growth.

Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which further education can play a constructive role. Individuals should also make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that further education genuinely contributes to their long-term development.

2021.apply_en:
The bar chart presents an uneven distribution among the categories associated with the exercise methods chosen by city residents. Working out alone accounts for the largest share, at slightly over half of the respondents. As for Working out alone and exercising with friends, they register slightly over half of the respondents and 47.7% respectively.

Changes reflected in physical exercise are closely linked to rising public awareness of personal health and increasingly favorable conditions for physical exercise. Improved sports infrastructure makes it easier for people to participate in physical exercise, while a wider range of exercise methods enables different groups to make choices suited to their own circumstances. As physical exercise becomes increasingly integrated into everyday life, the number of people willing to take part in related activities will continue to grow.

Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which physical exercise can play a constructive role. Individuals should also make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that physical exercise genuinely contributes to their long-term development.

体育锻炼所反映的变化，与公众健康意识的提高和公共运动条件的改善密切相关。更加完善的体育设施为人们参与体育锻炼提供了便利，而多样化的运动方式也使不同群体能够根据自身情况作出选择。随着体育锻炼逐渐融入日常生活，愿意参与相关活动的人数也会不断增加。

有关部门应提供必要支持，为体育锻炼发挥作用创造良好条件。个人也应结合自身情况作出合理选择，使体育锻炼真正服务于自身的长期发展。

2022.apply_en:
The bar chart shows that the items associated with express delivery volumes nationwide and in rural areas rose steadily during the periods presented. The national volume climbed from 51 billion pieces in 2018 to 83 billion pieces in 2020, while the rural volume rose from 12 billion pieces in 2018 to 30 billion pieces in 2020. From 2018 to 2020, The national volume rose from 51 billion pieces to 83 billion pieces, showing a steady upward trend.

Undoubtedly, the country's rapid economic growth has laid a solid material foundation for the emergence of express delivery. As the pace of life accelerates, individuals attach greater importance to convenience and efficiency and become increasingly willing to embrace new ways of living. Seen in this light, the development of express delivery is no coincidence but a natural consequence of broader changes in social life.

Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which express delivery can play a constructive role. Individuals should also make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that express delivery genuinely contributes to their long-term development.
2022.apply_cn:
该柱状图表明，与全国与农村的快递业务量有关的不同项目在相应时期内均持续上升。全国业务量由2018年的510亿件上升至2020年的830亿件，农村业务量则从2018年的120亿件增至2020年的300亿件。自2018年至2020年，全国业务量由510亿件升至830亿件，呈现稳定上升趋势。

毫无疑问，国家经济的飞速发展，为快递服务的出现奠定了坚实的物质基础。随着生活节奏加快，个人开始更加重视便利和效率，也更愿意接受新的生活方式。由此可见，快递服务的发展并非偶然，而是社会生活发生变化后的自然结果。

有关部门应提供必要支持，为快递服务发挥作用创造良好条件。个人也应结合自身情况作出合理选择，使快递服务真正服务于自身的长期发展。
